labels_note: `labels` (flat, item_id-keyed) contains ONLY HARM and OR_HARDBENIGN -- those ids are globally unique and identical to H1/results/graded_truth.json's, so this field stays drop-in join-compatible with H1. OR_XSTEST54 and HARM_XSTEST54 share the SAME 54 XSTest pair_uid ids (matched twins) and would silently overwrite each other in a flat dict; they live ONLY in `labels_by_set`, which is the AUTHORITATIVE field for every set. Every rate in rates.py is computed from `labels_by_set`, never from the flat `labels` dict.
